connect.title: Guhuza iyi telefone
connect.sub: Mushyiremo iyi kode kuri pr.social mu Bikoresho. Telefone izahuzwa yonyine.
connect.path: Kuri pr.social: Ibikoresho → Porogaramu ya serfing → mushyiremo kode.
connect.expired.sub: Kode imara iminota icumi. Musabe indi nshya.
connect.fail.network: Porogaramu izongera gusaba kode yonyine interineti igarutse.
connect.fail.often: Kode nyinshi zasabwe kuri uru rubuga. Mugerageze nyuma ya {min} min.
connect.fail.busy: pr.social iri gukora cyane. Mugerageze nyuma y'umunota umwe.
connect.done.title: Byahujwe
connect.off.sub: Yakuwe kuri konti yanyu kuri pr.social. Kugira ngo mongere muyihuze, mukoreshe kode nshya iri hepfo.
connect.no.tasks: Guhuza telefone bisaba imirimo yemejwe nibura {need}. Murangize imirimo kuri pr.social, hanyuma mwinjize iyi kode.
connect.no.devices: Konti yanyu imaze guhuzwa n'ibikoresho {max}. Mutandukanye kimwe kuri pr.social mu Bikoresho, hanyuma mwinjize iyi kode.
connect.no.device: Iyi telefone ntishobora guhuzwa. Mushyiremo porogaramu gusa uhereye kuri pr.social: emulator na telefone zifite root ntibishyigikirwa.
connect.no.restricted: Konti yanyu yakumiriwe. Telefone izashobora guhuzwa igihe uwo mupaka uzakurwaho.
connect.no.off: Porogaramu ya serfing ntiraboneka kuri konti yanyu.
stats.title: Imibare
limits.title: Imipaka
limits.hour.hint: Umubare w'imbuga iyi telefone ishobora kwerekana mu isaha
limits.day.hint: Umubare w'imbuga konti yanyu yose ishobora kwerekana ku munsi, ibikoresho byose hamwe
home.week.bars: Amafaranga iyi telefone yinjije mu minsi 7 ishize
home.ready: Imbuga zifungurwa zonyine, imwe nyuma y'indi, mu gihe porogaramu ifunguye ku ecran. Ecran ntizimira, ahubwo iracumbagira.
home.notready: Kwerekana bizatangira igihe ibi bizaba bikosowe
home.need.wifi: Muhuze na Wi-Fi cyangwa mwemere internet ya telefone
home.need.internet: Nta interineti: muhuze na Wi-Fi cyangwa internet ya telefone
home.need.charger: Mushyire telefone ku mashanyarazi cyangwa mwemere kwerekana ukoresheje batiri
home.need.battery: Mushyire telefone ku mashanyarazi: batiri iri munsi ya 20 %
home.need.cool: Telefone irashyushye: kwerekana bizatangira igihe izaba yakonje
home.update.hint: Irashyirwaho hejuru ya iyi verisiyo mu munota umwe. Konti yanyu n'amafaranga yinjiye bizakomeza kuba bihari.
home.update.allow: Android isaba uruhushya rwanyu rwo gushyiraho porogaramu ziva kuri PR Surf. Mwemere hanyuma musubire inyuma: umushyiramo azafungura wenyine.
home.update.failed.network: Gukururwa kwahagaze. Reba interineti yanyu hanyuma mongere mugerageze.
home.update.failed.space: Mukureho ibidakenewe muri telefone hanyuma mongere mugerageze.
home.update.failed.site: Ivugurura ntirishobora gukururwa. Mongere mugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.
gate.blocked.sub: PR.SOCIAL yafunze iyi telefone. Mwandikire Ubufasha: bazabasobanurira impamvu n'icyo mukora.
gate.restricted.sub: Mu gihe uwo mupaka ukiriho, serfing ntiyemewe. Ubufasha bazabasobanurira impamvu.
gate.update.sub: Iyi verisiyo ntigikora. Iyi nshya ishyirwaho mu munota umwe, konti n'amafaranga yinjiye bikazakomeza kuba bihari.
gate.closed.sub: Porogaramu irabigenzura yonyine, nta kintu mukeneye gukora. Serfing nibongera kuboneka, buto yo gutangira izagaruka.
fix.vpn.sub: Zimwe mu komande zibara abasura gusa iyo nta VPN ihari. Muzimye VPN kugira ngo mubone imbuga nyinshi.
wait.empty.sub: Imbuga nshya zigaragara igihe abamamaza batumije gusura. Isuzuma rikurikira ni saa {time}. Mukomeze gufungura porogaramu.
wait.busy.sub: Kwerekana bizakomeza saa {time}. Imbuga zamaze kwerekanwa ntizizimira.
wait.network.sub: Igerageza rikurikira ni saa {time}. Imbuga zamaze kwerekanwa ntizizimira.
pause.screen.sub: Kwerekana bizakomeza igihe muzagaruka muri porogaramu.
pause.no_wifi.sub: Muhuze na Wi-Fi cyangwa mwemere internet ya telefone.
pause.no_charger.sub: Imbuga zerekanwa gusa igihe telefone iri ku mashanyarazi.
pause.check_missed.sub: “Muracyahari?” ntiyasubijwe mu gihe. Kanda Gukomeza kugira ngo musubire ku kwerekana.
check.title: Muracyahari?
check.sub: Kanda buto iri hepfo kugira ngo mukomeze. Kwerekana biba bihagaritswe kugeza musubije.
journal.title: Amateka
journal.empty.title: Ntacyo kirajyaho
journal.empty: Imbuga porogaramu yerekana zizagaragara hano, buri yose ifite ikimenyetso cyerekana niba yabazwe cyangwa atariko.
journal.none: Nta mbuga ziri kuri uru rutonde.
why.LOAD: Urubuga ntirwafunguye. Ikibazo kiri ku ruhande rw'urubuga, si urwanyu.
why.DNS: Aderesi y'urubuga ntikora. Nta kintu mukeneye gukora.
why.TIMEOUT: Urubuga rwafunguye biratinze. Bishobora kuba ari urwo rubuga rutihuta, cyangwa interineti idakomeye: Wi-Fi akenshi irafasha.
why.HTTP: Urubuga rwasubije ikosa. Nta kintu mukeneye gukora.
why.SSL: Urubuga rufite icyemezo cy'umutekano kitemewe, ni yo mpamvu porogaramu itarufunguye.
why.BLOCKED: Uburinzi bw'urubuga ntibwemereye porogaramu gufungura paji.
why.VIDEO: Video ntiyatangiye: ishobora kuba yakuweho cyangwa yahishwe.
why.CRASH: Mushakisha ya porogaramu yahagaze kuri iyi paji maze isubukurwa.
why.EARLY: Porogaramu yatanze raporo y'urubuga mbere y'igihe cyo kurebwamo cyemewe. Mugenzure ko itariki n'igihe bya telefone bishyirwaho mu buryo bwikora.
why.SHORT: Paji ntiyari ku ecran igihe kihagije. Komeza porogaramu ifunguye kandi ecran ikaka.
why.VIDEO_SHORT: Video ntiyakinnye igihe kihagije: igihe cyagiye ku matangazo cyangwa guhagarara.
why.CONTROL: Iyi yari paji y'isuzuma ya pr.social, kandi ntiyerekanywe neza.
why.NOT_SHOWN: Kwerekana byahagaze bitaragera kuri uru rubuga.
why.RESTRICTED: Konti yanyu yakumiriwe: imbuga ntizibarwa kugeza igihe ibyo kumirwa bizakurwaho.
why.GONE: Porogaramu yatanze raporo y'urubuga itinze: yari imaze igihe kinini ifunze.
settings.title: Igenamiterere
settings.wifi.hint: Imbuga na video ntizakoresha amakuru ya telefone
settings.charging.hint: Ecran ikomeza kuba ikaka, bityo ibi bizigama batiri
settings.dim.hint: Iminota imwe nyuma yo gukoraho bwa nyuma, ecran igabanya urumuri kandi kwerekana bikomeza
settings.support.hint: Ibibazo ku bijyanye na porogaramu cyangwa ku mafaranga mwinjiza
settings.disconnect.ask: Iyi telefone ntizongera guhuzwa na @{user}. Mushobora kongera kuyihuza mukoresheje kode nshya.
toast.busy: pr.social iri gukora cyane. Mongere mugerageze mu minota imwe.
toast.mobile: Amakuru ya telefone yemerewe. Mushobora kubihindura mu igenamiterere.
toast.nocharger: Kwerekana byemerewe no ku batiri. Mushobora kubihindura mu igenamiterere.
toast.nobrowser: Nta mushakisha yabonetse yo gufungura pr.social
toast.noupdate: Verisiyo nshya ntirarangira. Mongere mugerageze nyuma.
settings.mini.hint: Iyo muvuye muri porogaramu, imbuga zikomeza kugaragara mu idirishya rito hejuru y'izindi porogaramu
settings.mini.denied: Mu igenamiterere rya telefone, “Ishusho mu ishusho” yazimye ku PR Surf
home.mini: Mu gihe kimwe mushobora gukoresha izindi porogaramu: imbuga zizakomeza kugaragara mu idirishya rito.
show.resumed: Kugaragaza byakomeje uhereye aho byari bihagaze
notify.stopped.sub: Kanda kugira ngo mukomeze: imbuga zizakomeza uhereye aho zari zihagaze.
skip.title: Guhagarika uru rubuga?
skip.r.adult: Ibirimo ni ibya bakuru cyangwa biteye ubwoba
